review.tagline: Persistent cross-session memory plugin for Claude Code and other coding agents
review.summary: Claude-Mem hooks into Claude Code session lifecycle events (SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PostToolUse, Stop, SessionEnd), records tool-usage observations and summaries in SQLite, and injects relevant context into later sessions. A local Bun-managed worker serves an HTTP API and web viewer, with hybrid FTS5 and Chroma vector search exposed through three MCP tools: search, timeline and get_observations. Installers also cover OpenCode, T3 Code, Antigravity, OMP, Pi and OpenClaw.
review.audience: Claude Code users who want context carried across sessions
strengths: Search, timeline, get_observations flow filters before fetching details; README claims ~10x token savings
Local SQLite storage with FTS5 plus Chroma hybrid search, and a web viewer for stored memory
One npx installer targets Claude Code, OpenCode, T3 Code, Antigravity, OMP, Pi and others
`<private>` tags exclude content from storage; settings live in ~/.claude-mem/settings.json
weaknesses: Default installer prompts for sign-in to a hosted observer with a 30-day trial, then paid
Needs Node 20+, Bun and uv; the last two are auto-installed
`npm install -g claude-mem` installs only the SDK, not the hooks or worker
Summaries are generated by an extra model (hosted, OpenRouter, Gemini or Anthropic plan), adding usage
needs: Needs Node.js 20+, Bun, uv, SQLite, Chroma
Models: Anthropic plan, OpenRouter, Gemini, claude-mem hosted observer
